draft.understanding: 用户希望复现论文表 1 中 FairBatch 在合成数据集上训练逻辑回归、以 equal opportunity 为公平性目标时的测试集 accuracy 和 EO disparity；仅针对 FairBatch 行，而非无公平约束的 LR 基线或其他数据集。

questions.text: 论文表 1 中，合成数据集上采用 FairBatch、逻辑回归模型并以 equal opportunity 为公平性目标时，测试集 accuracy 的跨次实验平均值是多少？
questions.locator: Table 1, FairBatch row, Synthetic group, Acc. column
questions.setting: Synthetic dataset; logistic regression trained with FairBatch for equal opportunity; separate test set
questions.protocol_notes: 论文说明所有实验以不同随机种子重复 10 次；表格以中心值和 ± 项呈现。合成数据采用训练/测试划分，EO 公平性目标，评估在独立测试集上进行；此问题针对中心值，不要求 ± 项。

questions.text: 论文表 1 中，合成数据集上采用 FairBatch、逻辑回归模型并以 equal opportunity 为公平性目标时，测试集 EO disparity 的跨次实验平均值是多少？
questions.metric: EO disparity = max over sensitive groups z of |Pr(predicted positive | z, true positive) − Pr(predicted positive | true positive)|
questions.locator: Table 1, FairBatch row, Synthetic group, EO Disp. column
questions.setting: Synthetic dataset; logistic regression trained with FairBatch for equal opportunity; separate test set
questions.protocol_notes: 论文说明所有实验以不同随机种子重复 10 次；表格以中心值和 ± 项呈现。按论文第 4 节的 EO disparity 定义计算测试集公平性；此问题针对中心值，不要求 ± 项。

items.comment: Table 1, FairBatch row, Synthetic Acc. column is the requested accuracy under LR with EO. The synthetic data files are provided as .npy with a train/test split, so the setting is concrete.

Table 1, FairBatch row, Synthetic EO Disp. column. The EO disparity definition in the draft matches Section 4 of the paper. The draft's metric line uses max over z of |Pr(ŷ=1|z,y=1) − Pr(ŷ=1|y=1)|, which is the paper's definition.
